_readme: Hand-picked exercise demonstrations. Key = KYVO exercise id. Each angle is either a video (sources + poster) or an image. Replace the sample files in public/media/demos/ with licensed 3D renders, keep the same shape, and set sample to false. A licensed pack imported with scripts/media/import-pack.mjs fills in every exercise not listed here.
